title: lane_presets loader silently skips non-object rows (or_continue) in the same block that claims 'never a silent skip' (ODN-5)
detail: Every malformation rejects with a typed error, but a preset entry that is not a JSON object is silently dropped and the load succeeds with fewer dial positions than balance.json declares — directly contradicting the same block's 'never a silent skip' bar.
recommended_fix: Reject instead of skipping: lo, lok := lv.(json.Object); if !lok { return {"balance.json", "lane_presets", "preset entry must be an object"} } — keep the loader uniformly fail-fast.

title: b.lane_presets leaks on every balance.json rejection after make — the cleanup in catalogs_destroy can never see it
detail: Every rejection after make() returns without freeing b.lane_presets, and cat.balance is only assigned on success, so catalogs_destroy's delete never sees the array — the dynamic plus its preset strings leak per rejected load, unlike the pre-make 'map' check.
recommended_fix: Free b.lane_presets before each rejection return after make, or validate into locals first and make once after all checks pass — matching the existing validate-before-allocate pattern.
